description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Locke], [ATK +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Mode
description.text: Fire abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, penetrate 20% DEF and RES; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single attack (11.00 each) capped at 199,999. Grants [Fire Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Fire Ability DEF and RES 30% Piercing (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Fire Ability +60% Boost (Tactical)] to user if Level 2+ EnFire, grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking] to user if not.

description.name: Fire Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Fire attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Fire Ability DEF and RES 30% Piercing (Tactical)
Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Fire Ability +60% Boost (Tactical)
description.text: Fire abilities deal 60% more damage, removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Attach Fire 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3
